text: レッドは　ほのおのポケモン　ヒトカゲに　するんじゃな？

structure.jp: ほのおのポケモン　ヒトカゲに

patterns.name: 〜にする
patterns.explanation: A thing followed by にする says you choose that thing. ヒトカゲにする = 'go with Charmander'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ after a verb gives the feeling of checking or explaining how things are. Here it is んじゃ, the old-man form. するんじゃ = 'so it is that you choose'.

patterns.name: 〜な (confirmation)
patterns.explanation: な at the end asks the listener to agree, like ね but in an older man's voice. するんじゃな = 'you're choosing it, right?'
